column1: # Vanilla 26.1.2 per-block light properties, from BlockStateBase.
# Generated by LightProbe.java; the same registry the dedicated server boots.
# A block gets one 'block' row when every state shares a triple, and one 'state' row per
# state otherwise. The range is on the row so a parser can apply it without the block
# registry; without it a row cannot be applied at all. Emission is 0..15, dampening 0..15.
